backward_compat_traps.rule: QSPI/OSPI adds multi-IO lines, dummy cycles, and a phase protocol; it is only single-IO SPI-compatible in 1-1-1.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Treating a QSPI device as a bare full-duplex SPI shifter ignores the address/dummy/data phases and reads garbage.

backward_compat_traps.rule: The dummy-cycle count must match the device's configured latency for the read mode and SCLK frequency.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Using too few dummy cycles at high frequency corrupts the data phase (the most common bring-up bug).

backward_compat_traps.rule: In Quad mode the /WP pin is IO2 and /HOLD (or /RESET) is IO3.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Leaving /WP or /HOLD asserted as control pins breaks Quad data transfer.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Devices >16 MB need 4-byte addressing (0xB7) or 4-byte opcodes.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Sending a 3-byte address to a 4-byte-mode device targets the wrong location.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Octal DDR (8D-8D-8D) requires DQS-based source-synchronous capture at high frequency.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Capturing DDR data off SCLK alone fails timing as frequency rises.

fields.spec_version: JEDEC Expanded Serial Peripheral Interface (xSPI) JESD251 (2020) + JESD251-1 (2021); SFDP per JESD216; common quad/octal SPI NOR-flash command conventions.
previous_versions: Quad SPI (vendor, ~2010) — 1-1-4 / 1-4-4 / 4-4-4 multi-IO reads over classic SPI NOR.
Octal SPI (vendor, ~2017) — x8 IO0-IO7, octal SDR/DDR.

key_changes.summary: Multi-IO data lines and the instruction-address-dummy-data phase protocol added over classic single-IO SPI.
JEDEC standardization: octal DDR 8D-8D-8D, DQS source-synchronous read, command extension byte, configuration-register interface, variable latency.

fields.version_naming_history_note: xSPI is JEDEC's standardization (JESD251) of the multi-IO 'Expanded SPI' that vendors shipped as Quad SPI and Octal SPI; SFDP is JESD216. Facts here are grounded in the public JEDEC xSPI and SFDP standards and common quad/octal SPI NOR-flash command conventions.
